import sympy as sp
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

b = 100
q_yes = sp.symbols('q_yes')
price_yes = sp.exp(q_yes / b) / (sp.exp(q_yes / b) + sp.exp(0 / b))  # Binary market

plt.show()
